nuggets.text: The Red Raiders won a school-record 12 games last season, along with their first Big 12 title.
Red Raiders coach Joey McGuire won three Texas state titles as head coach at Cedar Hill High School.
The Red Raiders beat Oregon State 45-14 last year with three different backs each topping 100 yards and scoring a touchdown.
Before last season, the Red Raiders had met Oregon State just once, winning 15-14 in 1959.
The Masked Rider became the Red Raiders' official mascot in 1954, leading the team onto the field at the Gator Bowl.
The Red Raiders' offensive line features five upperclassmen weighing a combined 1,565 pounds.
Raider Red was created in 1971, when conference rules limited live animals at road games.
The Goin' Band from Raiderland won the Sudler Trophy in 1999, an honor a band can receive only once.
Stone Harrington kicked four field goals in the Red Raiders' 33-10 opening win over Abilene Christian.
Pitt transfer Malcolm Simmons caught a 64-yard touchdown pass in the Red Raiders' opener.
